### Beat 1: Opening Excitement & Shared Atmosphere (0:00 – 0:18)
Open the video with the vibrant concert crowd and brightly lit stage to establish the feeling of collective joy and adventure. The clip’s natural audio and dialogue about longing for thrills and living in a dream carry the initial soundscape. [[clip: MVI_6216 | 0s-21.19s]]

### Beat 2: City Lights & Jazzy Rhythms (0:18 – 0:25)
Transition from the concert crowd to a nighttime urban perspective, tilting up toward glowing Times Square billboards to evoke the thrill of exploring metropolitan spaces. [[clip: MVI_3046 | 0s-7.01s]]
Introduce the smooth, rhythmic track "Everything Is Embarrassing" right as this clip begins, letting it establish an easygoing, tranquil momentum. [[sound: ab00ccd2-3938-420e-bb7a-93fda3780bf6]]

### Beat 3: Movement & Amusement (0:25 – 0:39)
Cut to the luminous purple spinning ride and roller coaster speeding through the dark, capturing the dynamic movement and wonder of nighttime attractions with friends. [[clip: MVI_3798 | 0s-14.81s]]
Cut to Created montage of clips of IMG_4401.mov, MVI_3798, and IMG_1614, all cropped to be horizontal, that lasts for approximately seven seconds.
Keep the music running underneath to bridge the urban scene with the amusement ride.

### Beat 4: Tranquil Stage Finale (0:39 – 1:00)
Keep the music running as the final clip starts, shifting focus to the beauty of nature to bring the 60-second piece to a calm, reflective close. [[clip: MVI_5751-compressed | 3s-26s]]ontage
